row.diff:
diff --git a/catalog.py b/catalog.py
index 9c6cbac..6412bc2 100644
--- a/catalog.py
+++ b/catalog.py
@@ -20,5 +20,14 @@ def find(products, sku):
 
 
 def remove_discontinued(products):
-    """The catalog without the products we no longer carry."""
-    raise NotImplementedError
+    """The catalog without the products we no longer carry.
+
+    Only products marked discontinued AND with zero stock are removed.
+    Discontinued products that still have stock stay listed until they sell
+    out; out-of-stock products that are not discontinued are kept.
+    A product with no stock field is kept.
+    """
+    return [
+        p for p in products
+        if not (p.get("status") == "discontinued" and p.get("stock") == 0)
+    ]
diff --git a/tests/test_catalog.py b/tests/test_catalog.py
index 0dd45c5..e0f3c92 100644
--- a/tests/test_catalog.py
+++ b/tests/test_catalog.py
@@ -15,3 +15,29 @@ def test_save_and_load(tmp_path):
     p = tmp_path / "catalog.json"
     catalog.save(p, PRODUCTS)
     assert catalog.load(p) == PRODUCTS
+
+
+def test_remove_discontinued():
+    before = list(PRODUCTS)
+    result = catalog.remove_discontinued(PRODUCTS)
+    assert [p["sku"] for p in result] == ["A1"]
+    assert PRODUCTS == before
+
+
+def test_remove_discontinued_keeps_out_of_stock_active():
+    items = [{"sku": "C3", "name": "Bowl", "price": 5.0, "stock": 0, "status": "active"}]
+    assert catalog.remove_discontinued(items) == items
+
+
+def test_remove_discontinued_keeps_discontinued_with_stock():
+    items = [
+        {"sku": "D4", "name": "Plate", "price": 4.0, "stock": 3, "status": "discontinued"},
+        {"sku": "E5", "name": "Cup", "price": 3.0, "stock": 0, "status": "discontinued"},
+    ]
+    result = catalog.remove_discontinued(items)
+    assert [p["sku"] for p in result] == ["D4"]
+
+
+def test_remove_discontinued_keeps_item_without_stock_field():
+    items = [{"sku": "F6", "name": "Jug", "price": 9.0, "status": "discontinued"}]
+    assert catalog.remove_discontinued(items) == items
